name: Haircut Number Two Hundred
why_it_works: A visit count is loyalty made visible. Watching one regular across years makes the place feel like a home, not a transaction, and newcomers want to belong to something that lasts. The number in the hook is oddly specific, so people stop to read it.

hook.pattern: Lead with a large, specific visit number for one real regular, then jump back to visit one.
examples: We've seen him through three jobs and two kids.

variables.name: visit_noun
variables.description: What one visit is called in this business, 2 words or fewer

variables.name: constant_spot
variables.description: The spot that never changes (chair, stool, booth, bay), 2 words or fewer

variables.name: regular_name
variables.description: First name of the regular, with permission

variables.name: visit_count
variables.description: Their visit number, a real figure

variables.name: first_visit_detail
variables.description: What the first visit looked like, spoken, 8 words or fewer
variables.example: he wanted a fade for prom

variables.name: life_moment
variables.description: A life moment the business was part of, spoken, 6 words or fewer

variables.name: offer
variables.description: What a new customer gets, starting with a capital letter, 6 words or fewer

beats.purpose: hook: the count, with the real regular

visual.prompt: Client-supplied photo of the real regular {{regular_name}} at {{brand}} today, taken with their written consent, warm light, candid
Client-supplied old snapshot of {{regular_name}}'s first visit at {{brand}}, shared with consent; if none exists, use text_only over an old photo of the empty shop
Client-supplied photo of {{regular_name}} at {{brand}} around {{life_moment}}, shared with written consent

beats.purpose: the turn: the chair as a constant
beats.voiceover: Jobs changed. Neighborhoods changed. The {{constant_spot}} didn't.

visual.prompt: Slow orbit around the empty {{constant_spot}} at {{brand}} at closing time, warm light, slight haze, no people, vertical 9:16

craft.notes: Use the regular's real photos from across the years so time passing is visible at a glance. The constant spot carries the theme; the people change around it. End on the empty {{constant_spot}} so the viewer imagines sitting in it.

do_not: Use a regular without asking them
Overload with every life event; pick one
Generate a face to stand in for the real regular
compliance: The regular is a real customer: real photos only, with written consent to use their name, face and visit count
